title: Sky Reach · falls to a shader graph
subtitle: The islands' waterfall sheets (foam streaks, fraying spray, plunge mist): ShaderMaterial GLSL vs an SF59 unlit graph (G382 / G387). iPhone 16 Pro portrait, phone tier.
notes: Same sheet shape, spread, fray and mist; the main foam streak keeps the old value noise, the softer layers use the graph's gradient noise.
Colours converted to linear (the old program wrote display values); still unfogged, alpha-blended, no depth write; runs on the renderer's clock.
AFTER: the blue-teal body reads a touch darker between the foam ropes.
